ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, with black pixels dominating over 95% of the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity dark region across both lobes. Small, isolated high-contrast white pixel clusters (mottling) distributed primarily across the mid-section of the left lobe and lower central region near the fluke base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging between 5 and 20 pixels, distinct against the lighter background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white clusters ranging from 2-8 pixels in diameter scattered across the central and left-lobe surfaces.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity pixel clusters (water spray/foam) occluding the lower margins and central base of the fluke.
